title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
BTC.D +3.0% (24h) → 59.2% — dominance reversing sharply from Fri's 57.6%; altcoin rotation unwinding.
TOTAL2 (ex-BTC) −6.6% (24h) → $1.10T — alts selling off hard into ECB/CPI/FOMC week.
TOTAL3 (ex-BTC, ex-ETH) −9.5% (24h) → $799B — small caps worst hit; BTC Accumulation dial intact.
BTC holding $79,963 (+0.4%); $278M in longs liquidated overnight. CPI Sep 11, FOMC Sep 16.
